attributes.name: Ivory Dice
attributes.powers:
When you encounter this card, roll 1d6. On 1-3, shuffle it into a random open location; on 4-6, acquire it.

When you would fail a check, reveal this card and choose odd or even. Then roll 1d6. If the roll matches your choice, recharge this card to succeed at the check. If the roll does not match, bury 3 cards from your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Ivory Dice, change the check to acquire from "See Below" to "None."
corrections.issue: Can I play a card like Swipe or Princeling to acquire the Ivory Dice?
